theme: An open day, with Croatia on the clock.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is genuinely empty today — a rare open stretch with the girls in St. Petersburg — so the real pull is the stack of Croatia bookings that has to close before you fly the 8th.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England call at noon
needsAttention.detail: Your one commitment this week is tomorrow at 12 PM ET with the NACD New England chapter. Worth arriving with two or three board-fit talking points and the specific seats you're targeting.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings still open
needsAttention.detail: Several P1 travel items are overdue and have to be locked before you fly Sept 8, since the charter has no connectivity: the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer, the Sept 20-22 St Pete landing gap, and written proof that checked bags are on the ticket.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: Due today so it's built before the Sept 3 house changeover — the first migration is meant to be a test run while there's still time to fix what's missing.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing invoice still open
flagged.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 for the Croatia charter unpaid with a balance due — worth clearing before departure.

inbox.noise: A run of Care.com applicants and reminders on your caregiver post; nothing there needs a reply.

recipe.title: Green Salad with Green Beans
recipe.why: Late-August green beans are at their snappy, sweet peak right now, so this is the moment to let them carry a simple salad before summer tips into fall.

tasks.title: Book Cavtat hotel + noon transfer for Sept 19
Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
Book refundable backup SUV, Sept 20 - Oct 5
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: A rare fully open morning — still water on the calendar, nothing scheduled to pull you off course.
The clear stretch holds; the girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, no handoff this week.
The week's single commitment sits just over the horizon at noon tomorrow.
